summary: Small indeterminate loading indicator for a local wait, such as inside a button or a panel that is loading.

usage.text: It shows activity only. Announce when loading starts and ends with text in a status region of your own, and remove the spinner when done.
Under prefers-reduced-motion the rotation slows to 1.6 seconds per turn rather than stopping.

a11y.text: Unless decorative, it is role img named by the label attribute, default "Loading". It is not a live region, so it announces nothing when it appears.
Set decorative when visible text nearby, such as "Saving...", already says it is loading; it is then hidden from assistive technology.
